selection_policy: Events and six-hour windows were fixed from authoritative event reports before model errors were inspected. Bounding boxes are event-centred and do not depend on either model.

source.evidence: The historical cold event affected Texas on 11-20 February 2021; the coldest night followed 15 February.
Surigae reached 895 hPa and 120 kt at 18 UTC on 17 April 2021.
The record heat peaked west of the Cascades on 28 June 2021.
The evaluation window covers the 12-18 UTC intensification and landfall period on 29 August 2021.
Chanthu deepened from 910 hPa at 06 UTC to 905 hPa at 18 UTC on 10 September 2021.
Rai reached its first 915 hPa, 105 kt peak at 06 UTC on 16 December 2021.
